column1: # Accepted deviations for tools/verify_arxiv.py: differences between a bibliography entry and the
# arXiv or Crossref record that are known, checked, and correct in the entry.
# One per line, tab-separated: key, field, value, reason.
#   field  the start of the tool's message: "author 5", "author count", "journal", "volume", "pages"
#   value  the value the record gives, as it appears in the message
#   reason why the entry is right and the record is not used
# A mismatch is accepted only if its key, field and value all match a line. Checked 2026-11-13.
